_note: BANDS THAT APPEAR ON SEVERAL PAGES.
Each block below is one horizontal band of the site. Editing it changes
every page that band appears on.
whoWeAre     — the Lab / Studio pair of panels (home + About)
techMarquee  — the scrolling list of technologies (home + About)
socials      — the Follow Along grid (home, About, Products, Contact)
callToAction — the big closing invitation at the foot of most pages

heading.title: A lab and an agency,
heading.description: Most studios only ship other people's software. We do both, and the two halves make each other sharper — our products keep us honest about maintenance, and client work keeps us honest about deadlines.

_note: Two panels side by side. `colour` tints the icon, the bullets and the
glow that follows your mouse — either "ember" (red) or "volt" (blue).
`kicker` is the small grey text in the top-right corner.
panels.title: The Lab
panels.blurb: Five products of our own in the market. We fund them, run them, and get paged when they break — which is exactly why our engineering opinions are worth something.
points: Everything we learn goes back into client work

panels.title: The Studio
panels.blurb: Senior squads embedded with your team. We take the same standards we hold our own products to and point them at your roadmap.
points: Your repo, your infra, your IP from commit one

_note: The two rows of technology names that scroll in opposite directions.
They are split into two rows automatically, so just keep one flat list.
